decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean on pool3' (a seeded deterministic baseline) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score -0.2166. Series context: trend strength 0.9146 and seasonal strength 0.1129; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.478); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 72.864.
